first_barrier_schedule.conflict_edge_union: the union of the ten graph edges in every current forbidden five-set
first_barrier_schedule.eligible_edge_rule: force every one of the 903 edges that is outside the conflict-edge union, plus every conflict-union edge whose exact post-flip objective exceeds four
first_barrier_schedule.meaning_of_zero_limit: no truncation; use every eligible edge
first_barrier_schedule.exact_replay: recount every forced graph before its repair rollout
first_barrier_schedule.rationale: Conflict-union moves that remain at E<=4 are exactly the move type already closed in the prior finite closure. Every scheduled first edge therefore leaves that targeted closure.

acceptance: all 53 seeds independently recount to E=3 or E=4
all forced-barrier incremental heights match exact conflict recounts
the result binds the frozen source, binary, inputs, parameters, and output hashes
any E=0 graph is immediately checked by both independent Ramsey verifiers before any construction claim
any E=2 graph is independently recounted and quotient-classified before a novelty claim
stopping_rule: Run the complete frozen first-barrier schedule once. Stop early only for a replay failure, resource-safety failure, or an E=0 construction requiring immediate independent verification.
claim_boundary: The first forced edge schedule is exhaustive only relative to the 53 retained classes and the stated outside-closure rule. Every subsequent repair trajectory is heuristic. No failure can imply nonexistence.
